subject: Bespoke retention and deletion: NorthBridge Health order-form discussion
messages:
From: Marta Romero <marta.romero@northbridgehealth.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: data-procurement@northbridgehealth.com
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:14:00 +0000
Subject: Bespoke retention/deletion windows + evidence request

Hi Markus,

Thanks for taking this initial call last week. NorthBridge is evaluating Redwood for embedding and triage workflows across several EU patient-facing services. Before legal/infosec will sign, we need clarity on two bespoke items for the order form:

1) Residency: all customer content (input + generated output + KV caches + backups) must remain in EU regions only (no dual-region replication outside EU).
2) Retention windows: we need a hot-tier retention of 30 days, a cold encrypted snapshot tier of up to 12 months, and a final guaranteed deletion timeline after contract termination.
3) Deletion evidence: we require an auditable certificate of deletion for backups and snapshots within 45 days of termination, and confirmation of the technical steps you take to render data unrecoverable.

Can you send proposed order-form language and a concise technical note that we can attach to the SOW? Also let us know if any of this requires a Dedicated or Private deployment and whether there are additional fees.

Best,
Marta Romero
Head of Data Governance
NorthBridge Health

(attachment: compliance-matrix-template.xlsx)

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 11:02:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Bespoke retention/deletion windows + evidence request

Hi Marta — thanks for the clear list.

Summary of Redwood's starting position:
- Residency: We can guarantee EU-only storage and compute (deployments pinned to eu-west-1/2).
- Typical retention: hosted default is 90-day hot cache + 7-day cold snapshots in the hosted tier; Dedicated/Private gives you more control over snapshot lifecycle.
- Deletion artifacts: we provide deletion logs and can produce a certified deletion statement; standard timeline is 60 days for full snapshot purge on hosted.

I attached a sample-orderform-draft that includes two optional rows you can use: 30d hot + 12m cold (customer-managed snapshot lifecycle) and an accelerated deletion add-on (guaranteed purge within 30 days for an additional fee).

Quick questions so we propose precise language:
- Do you require Redwood-managed keys or customer-managed KMS?
- Is the 45-day certificate a hard requirement or a target?

If you want, Priyom can circulate a redline that maps your ask to the order form and call out where Dedicated/Private is required.

Thanks — I'll follow up with the draft.

Best,
Markus Klein
Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: Marta Romero <marta.romero@northbridgehealth.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: data-procurement@northbridgehealth.com
Date: Thu, 03 Dec 2026 08:47:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Bespoke retention/deletion windows + evidence request

Markus —

Thanks. To be explicit about NorthBridge's requirements (driven by national health regs and our internal retention policy):
- Hot-tier: 30 days (must be immediately purgeable on request).
- Cold-tier: up to 12 months, encrypted at rest. No copies outside EU.
- Deletion after termination: all live data + KV caches purged within 14 calendar days of contract termination. All cold backups/snapshots must be purged within 45 calendar days.
- Evidence: a signed certificate stating which objects were deleted and the IDs/timestamps, plus S3-style audit logs showing delete operations. Certificate must be delivered within 45 calendar days.

KMS: customer-managed key required. Private deployment preferred, but we are open to Dedicated if there is a clear SLA and no cross-tenant backups.

We will need a single-line SLA clause to insert into the order form and a short technical appendix that describes how you will purge KV caches, ephemeral logs, and retained snapshots so our auditors can understand the mechanism.

Regards,
Marta

PS: deal id for our side is NBH-RFI-011 — please reference in the order form.

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Marta Romero <marta.romero@northbridgehealth.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 04 Dec 2026 14:21:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Bespoke retention/deletion windows + evidence request

Hi Marta — looping in Sales Ops response and suggested redlines.

High-level constraints and proposed language (redline attached):
1) Residency: we confirm EU-only for all active storage and compute. We will not replicate data outside EU without written authorization.
2) KMS: customer-managed KMS is available on Private deployments and as an add-on for Dedicated; hosted API can support Bring-Your-Own-Key (BYOK) with limitations. This should be captured in section 2.3.
3) Retention & deletion: we propose the following order-form addendum text: 
   - "Hot-tier: up to 30 days (configurable). Cold-tier snapshots: up to 12 months.
   - Upon contract termination or earlier written request, Redwood will initiate a deletion process for live data and KV caches within 14 calendar days and will purge cold snapshots within 45 calendar days, unless the customer selects the Accelerated Deletion Add-on which guarantees purge within 30 calendar days for cold snapshots."
4) Evidence: Redwood will provide an execution report (objects deleted + timestamps + S3-style audit logs) within 30 calendar days of completion of purge (we can stretch to 45 days on a one-off commitment).

We attached a redline-orderform.docx with two flavors: (A) Hosted with Accelerated Deletion Add-on, (B) Private (preferred for NBH) which includes BYOK and standard 45-day snapshot purge.

Note on technical mechanics (short):
- Live KV caches: purge triggered via runtime-level invalidate + compaction sweep; we will provide an audit trail showing invalidate commands, cache eviction markers, and consequent GC.
- Snapshots: scheduled snapshot deletion and block-level zeroing where supported; for cloud-managed storage we will provide delete object events and confirmation of object missingness via list-objects checks.

Next steps: Markus — please confirm which option NBH prefers so we can move to a DocuSign draft.

Regards,
Priyom Das
Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
(attachment: redline-orderform.docx)

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Marta Romero <marta.romero@northbridgehealth.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, legal@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 05 Dec 2026 16:42:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Bespoke retention/deletion windows + evidence request

Marta — thanks for the clear asks and the back-and-forth. Quick operational clarification and recommended order-form wording below.

Technical clarifications: 
- KV caches: we will execute an immediate invalidate call across the serving fleet; this marks entries for eviction and prevents future rehydration. The physical memory will be reclaimed on compaction; runtime emits an "invalidate" audit log entry per node.
- Snapshots/backups: for Private deployments snapshots are customer-owned; Redwood will schedule snapshot object deletions and provide a delete manifest (object keys + timestamps). For hosted/Dedicated we maintain snapshot metadata and object deletions will be performed within the agreed purge window.
- Cryptographic erasure: for BYOK flows, destroying the CMK makes remaining ciphertext irrecoverable; we will include the CMK destruction event in the deletion certificate if the customer requests this mechanism.

Suggested single-line SLA to add to the order form: 
"Redwood will retain live request data for up to 30 days and cold snapshot copies for up to 12 months in EU-only regions. Upon customer's written termination or written request, Redwood will purge live data and KV caches within 14 calendar days and will purge cold snapshots within 45 calendar days (30 calendar days with the Accelerated Deletion Add-on). Redwood will deliver a deletion report including object identifiers, timestamps, and relevant audit logs within 45 calendar days of purge completion."

If NBH confirms Private deployment with BYOK, we will replace the 45-day standard with a 30-day target for snapshot purge and include CMK destruction steps.

Next steps: 
1) Marta — confirm Private vs Dedicated/Hosted and whether you accept the Accelerated Add-on fee or prefer Private with BYOK.
2) Priyom — I'll ask Legal to draft the final addendum and push to DocuSign (reference NBH-RFI-011 / NBH-2026-042).

Appreciate the partnership — happy to hop on a short call if you prefer.

Best,
Markus Klein
Account Executive, EMEA
Redwood Inference
